translations.web: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
translations.bsb: But Job has not directed his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.
translations.kjv: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
translations.asv: For he hath not directed his words against me; Neither will I answer him with your speeches.
